raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image and mark each bond that connects two non-hydrogen atoms, skipping the curved arrows and any bonds to written H atoms. Count the heavy-atom connections: top-left R to ring C; ring C to upper central C; upper central C to O of OH; upper central C to right ring C; right ring C to upper-right R; right ring C to lower-right imine C; lower-right C to N as one double bond; N to lower-left ring C; lower-left ring C to top-left ring C; lower-left ring C to side-chain carbon; side-chain carbon to lower-left R. The total from this checklist is 11.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态有机结构，包含一个六元环样骨架，周围标有多个 R 基团、一个 OH、一个 N，以及若干写出的 H；图中还有弯曲箭头。按照题意，弯曲箭头不计，所有涉及氢的键不计，只数非氢原子之间的连接。
推理：逐一数非氢原子间的键：1）左上 R 与环碳；2）该环碳与上方中心碳；3）上方中心碳与 OH 中的 O；4）上方中心碳与右侧环碳；5）右侧环碳与右上 R；6）右侧环碳与右下亚胺碳；7）右下碳与 N 的双键按一个重键连接计；8）N 与左下环碳；9）左下环碳与左上环碳；10）左下环碳与左侧侧链碳；11）侧链碳与左下 R。合计为 11 个非氢原子间的键。

method.method_draft: Reconstruct the heavy-atom graph from the image. First count the six bonds around the main heterocyclic framework: upper-left C–top C, top C–upper-right C, upper-right C–right imine C, right imine C=N, N–lower-left C, and lower-left C–upper-left C. Then count the five non-hydrogen substituent bonds attached to that framework: upper-left C–R, top C–O of OH, upper-right C–R, lower-left C–side-chain C, and side-chain C–R. Add 6 framework bonds and 5 substituent bonds to obtain 11.
